title: WSET Level 2 Grapes and Regions: the 15 Grapes You Must Know
description:
WSET Level 2 Wines in one study session: the principal grapes, the regions where they make their best-known wines, and how a cool or warm climate changes their style. With maps, the regional grapes examiners love, the pairs students confuse, and a quick quiz at the end.

Practise free on https://thewinegoat.com/
Read the full guide: https://thewinegoat.com/wset-level-2-grapes-and-regions/

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:38 Cool or warm climate?
1:26 White grapes
3:33 Black grapes
6:26 Regional grapes often asked
7:49 Quick quiz
8:48 Practise free
